title: Oracle Fact Sheet: Stargate Data Centers (Rep. Brett Hedges, 2025-09-23)
notes: Congressional fact sheet. Four Stargate sites: Abilene TX (flagship, up and running on OCI, ERCOT grid, GE Vernova natural gas backup), Shackelford County TX (Jenbacher gas microgrid), Doña Ana County NM, Midwest (unnamed). Abilene = the OCI Supercluster where Suno trains (170/171).
